headline: 3M Reports Fourth-Quarter 2018 Results
body: Full-year 2018 sales rose 3.5% to $32.8 billion and GAAP EPS was $8.89, up from $7.93; 3M returned $8.1 billion to shareholders.

headline: 3M Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2022 Results
body: Fourth-quarter adjusted EPS was $2.28 and organic growth was 0.4%, below the 1 to 3% 3M expected, as consumer markets weakened and COVID slowed demand in China.

headline: 3M Reports Second Quarter 2023 Results; Proactive Initiatives Drive Strong Quarterly Financial Results; Raises Full-Year Adjusted EPS Guidance
body: A $10.3 billion pre-tax charge for the PFAS public water systems settlement made GAAP EPS a loss of $12.35; 3M raised its full-year adjusted EPS outlook to $8.60 to $9.10.

headline: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2022 Financial Results
body: Full-year revenue rose 44% to $23.6 billion; fourth-quarter revenue was $5.6 billion, with GAAP net income of $21 million.

headline: American Express Delivers on 2022 Growth Plan With Full Year Revenue Growth of 25% and Earnings Per Share of $9.85
body: Full-year revenue rose 25% to $52.9 billion and net income was $7.5 billion; the company guided to 15 to 17% revenue growth for 2023.

headline: Boeing Reports Fourth-Quarter Results
body: Fourth-quarter revenue was $20.0 billion with a GAAP loss of $1.06 per share; Boeing delivered 480 commercial airplanes in 2022 and ended the year with a $404 billion backlog.

headline: PepsiCo Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2022 Results; Provides 2023 Financial Outlook
body: Full-year net revenue rose 8.7% to $86.4 billion and core EPS was $6.79; PepsiCo raised its annualized dividend by 10%.

headline: Amcor Reports Fiscal 2023 Results and Provides Outlook for Fiscal 2024
body: Net sales were $14.7 billion and adjusted EBIT was $1.6 billion; the CEO said demand softened and customer destocking continued through the last two quarters.

headline: Ulta Beauty Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2023 Results
body: Fourth-quarter net sales rose to $3.55 billion from $3.23 billion, comparable sales grew 2.5%, and net income was $394.4 million, or $8.08 per diluted share.
